projects.title: Don Macchiatos Web POS
projects.description: A hardened web-based coffee shop POS migrated from an Excel/VBA workflow. It includes Cash and GCash checkout, promo and Senior Citizen discount rules, ingredient-level stock deduction, replenishment and transfers, recipes and costing, sales reports, PDF/email reporting, transaction audit, users, security, and backup/restore tools.

projects.title: BrewPoint – Coffee Shop POS SaaS
projects.description: A multi-tenant cloud POS and back-office platform built for coffee shops. BrewPoint includes Cash and GCash checkout, recipe-based ingredient deduction, inventory and costing, expenses, reports, customers, promotions, staff and branch management, subscription controls, and a platform-owner landlord console.

projects.title: Scrapella – Private Social Scrapbook
projects.description: A private social scrapbook and memory platform for couples, families, and groups. Scrapella includes profiles and unique @tags, private invitations and membership, book-style journal pages, Memory Stream, shared posts, photo editing and text wrapping, responsive layouts, persistent accounts and media, and an Android wrapper connected to the production Railway backend.
